_about: Seed test set for RemoteClassifier. These 46 cases were written by hand to cover the failure modes that naive keyword matching hits. They are synthetic — modelled on real HN 'Who is hiring' phrasing but not copied from it. Replace and extend with real labelled postings from live threads; that is what makes the accuracy number mean something.

_schema.text:
the posting body as it would arrive (HTML entities and

tags included where realistic)
_schema.header: the first line, which the classifier treats as semi-structured
